title: Get the Perfect Pancake Flip
content: Wait for bubbles to form and pop across the surface before flipping — that's when the underside is set.

title: Basic Knife Skills for Faster Prep
content: Curl your fingertips under (the 'claw grip') to guide the knife safely while chopping.

title: Season In Layers, Not At the End
content: Add a little salt at each cooking stage rather than all at once — it builds deeper, more balanced flavour.

title: Always Rest Your Meat
content: Let grilled or roasted meat rest for 5-10 minutes before cutting so the juices redistribute instead of spilling out.

title: Freeze Fresh Herbs in Olive Oil
content: Chop leftover herbs, pack into an ice tray, cover with olive oil and freeze — instant flavour cubes for later.

title: Ripen Bananas Faster
content: Place bananas in a paper bag with an apple overnight to speed up ripening for banana bread.

title: Why Double-Frying Makes Crispier Fries
content: The first fry cooks the potato through; the second, hotter fry crisps the outside without burning it.

title: Blend Soups Safely
content: Let hot soup cool slightly and blend in small batches, venting the lid, to avoid dangerous steam pressure.

title: How to Cook Fluffy Rice Every Time
content: Rinse rice until water runs clear to remove surface starch, then let it steam undisturbed for 15 minutes.
